kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the progression definitions, the nomenclature table, and the grade-vs-stage block; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The five-frame rule (the definition, the progression cascade with its molecular gates, the nomenclature axis, the grade-vs-stage fork, the TNM priority) — KYP's synthesis of the two-page spread into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the blocks sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (THE BASEMENT MEMBRANE IS THE LINE / CARCINOMA EPITHELIAL SARCOMA MESENCHYME / GRADE DIFFERENTIATES STAGE SPREADS / M N T THE PROGNOSTIC PRIORITY) — no mnemonic prints on either page.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 215-216 (VLM census confirmed); the four codes are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on either page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for both pdf 237 and pdf 238). The nomenclature table and the grade-vs-stage block are pure text, carried verbatim in the note's tables. No copyrighted photographs; no margin mnemonics (VLM confirmed on both); the KYP memory layer is original.
